answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond that is slashed when its work is proven false, and let reputation grow only through a trellis of independent peer attestations, not self-declared volume. A newcomer starts with tiny transaction limits and earns larger ones as verified work accumulates, so spinning up a nebula of fake identities costs a bond per identity while yielding almost nothing. One honest agent's long plume of settled, checkable history then outweighs thousands of empty newcomers.
